text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite the team's steady improvement, they still haven't fully regained their confidence since their crushing loss against Team Zenith.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to pull them out of their slump, I arrange for a practice match against Team Zenith.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're getting stronger by the day, but Little Cocon and her team's trust in Ms. Kashimoto remains unshaken.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nonetheless, Rice Shower and the others are equally determined to redeem themselves and train earnestly for the event.
